provenance.title: Maternal sepsis — the first-response bundle
provenance.primarySource: WHO Statement on maternal sepsis; Surviving Sepsis / hour-1 bundle adapted for the obstetric patient
provenance.why: A septic pregnant or postpartum woman compensates until she does not, and the death is the one where treatment waited for a culture or a confirmed source. The bundle is time-critical and deliberately does not wait on either.

sourceVerification.note: No WHO SMART DAK; transcribed from the WHO maternal-sepsis statement and the hour-1 sepsis bundle adapted for obstetrics. Time windows are an engineering seed pending ratification. blocksRatification stays true.

steps.name: Blood cultures before antibiotics
steps.action: Take blood cultures — but do not let this delay antibiotics; if cultures cannot be taken at once, give antibiotics anyway.

steps.name: Broad-spectrum antibiotics
steps.action: Give broad-spectrum antibiotics within the first hour, empirically. Waiting for the source or the culture is the delay that kills.

steps.name: IV fluid resuscitation
steps.action: Two large-bore cannulae and a balanced-crystalloid fluid challenge, reassessing response.

steps.name: Measure lactate
steps.action: Measure lactate as a marker of tissue hypoperfusion and to track response; a rising lactate is deterioration.

steps.name: Identify and control the source
steps.action: Find the source — uterus (retained products, endometritis), chest, urinary tract, wound, breast — and control it; a septic abortion or retained products needs evacuation, not antibiotics alone.

steps.name: Escalate and monitor
steps.action: Call for senior help, monitor urine output and observations continuously, and arrange higher-level care or transfer early.
